lint/refuse-marker-key-vector-drift-from.reason: reads the agentibrain kernel dev checkout an earlier step clones into .marker-kernel

lint/refuse-changelog-fragments-named-of.reason: its BRANCH env reads github.head_ref and github.ref_name, which the lab context does not supply

lint/require-trusted-actors-before-priva.reason: its HEAD_SHA env reads the github pull request event, which the lab context does not supply

lint/fail-on-known-vulnerabilities-new-a.reason: runs pip-audit through uvx against the online vulnerability database

lint/run-every-swarm-ledger-dashboard-qu.reason: starts a ClickHouse container and runs the antoncore dashboard checker that earlier steps check out and install; its env reads github.run_id

lint/hold-the-hive-member-nats-grants-eq.reason: reads the antoncore checkout in .antoncore and pip installs cryptography

lint/artifact-sanity-checks.reason: its if reads steps.artifacts.outputs.browser and it drives the Playwright browser an earlier step installs

lint/prove-the-mutation-gate-kills-with-.reason: its if reads steps.self-plant.outputs.changed and it runs tests under mutation in the dev extras an earlier step installs

type-gate/install-dependencies.reason: a setup step that grades nothing: its if reads steps.venv.outputs.cache-hit and its PyPI fallback needs the network

type-gate/hold-the-strict-type-checker-s.reason: reads the base measurement an earlier step of its job writes under the runner temp type baseline folder

semgrep/scan/fail-on-findings-new-agains.reason: its BASE env reads steps.baseline.outputs.sha and its CONFIGS name Semgrep registry rule packs fetched online

semgrep/charts/guard-rules-hold-on-their.reason: fetches the base branch from origin before it grades

test-count/install-dependencies.reason: its cache condition reads the earlier venv action output and its fallback installs dependencies from PyPI

test-count/fetch-the-base-suite-count-re.reason: reads the app token action outcome and token output and downloads the recorded suite count artifact from GitHub

test-count/hold-the-base-revision-s-test.reason: reads the day action output and suite collection, review and base count records prepared earlier in the job

test-count/record-the-head-count-for-the.reason: requires the merge group event and an earlier collected suite count, while plant grades use the pull request event
